entities.summary: Roland Riz was an Italian lawyer, politician and academic from South Tyrol. A member of the South Tyrolean People's Party, he served in the Chamber of Deputies from 1958 to 1963 and 1968 to 1987 and served in the Senate of the Republic from 1987 to 1996.
